_readme: THE MERRIMACK'S ENTRANCE BAR IN DAYLIGHT, THE WATER ON ITS DATA'S OWN TIME (WATER_V2 section 12).
The water -- the tide, the forecast sea, the solver -- runs on the scene's clock, time.start, which is
'now': the data's time. The sun is held at local noon on its own two clocks (sun.clock, the season;
sun.earth.clock, the time of day; rate 0 holds them), so the bar can be judged in daylight whatever
the tide is doing. The two are not coupled: change one and the other stays.
Launch from the repo root:  build/bin/gagame.exe scenes/demos/merrimack_bar.json
Views: bar_low (the default) looks south-west along the bar from just off its crest; entrance_east
looks out between the jetties over it; entrance_west looks up the river past the north jetty.
FLY: W A S D move, Q / E down / up, hold the right mouse button to look.
